name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Feature: WAN bandwidth capping (WanCapMode/WanMaxBitrateMbps) previously only worked for a Direct-mode Jellyfin peer, where it asks the remote to transcode down to a lower bitrate via a querystring - it silently did nothing for a Plex source or any Jellyfin peer explicitly set to Proxy mode, since neither has a remote transcoder to ask. Manual mode now enforces an actual byte-rate throttle in the proxy relay itself, so a fixed bandwidth limit works for any proxied source. Auto (which relies on a Jellyfin-only bandwidth probe) is now an explicit no-op for a non-Jellyfin peer instead of settling permanently on a 10Mbps placeholder it could never move past - config page copy updated to match. 276 tests, all green.
